scenario.topic: Choose a workshop topic for the office learning day

options.name: Effective Communication Skills
options.upside: Improves team collaboration and reduces misunderstandings.
options.concern: May cover familiar concepts for some participants.

options.name: Introduction to Data Analysis with Excel
options.upside: Enhances practical data handling skills relevant to many roles.
options.concern: Requires participants to bring laptops and have prior Excel familiarity.

options.name: Time Management and Productivity Techniques
options.upside: Helps employees organize tasks and improve work efficiency.
options.concern: Some may find techniques less applicable to their work style.

options.name: Basics of Cybersecurity Awareness
options.upside: Raises awareness of security risks and safe online practices.
options.concern: Technical content may be challenging for non-technical participants.

shared_context: The office learning day aims to enhance employees' skills through interactive workshops. Three participants will decide on one workshop topic that fits a 2-hour session and appeals to diverse professional interests.

personas.name: Maya
personas.background: Maya is a project manager focused on improving team productivity and organization.
personas.private_goal: To select a workshop that helps employees better manage their time and tasks.

A.reason_for: Improves team collaboration, which supports productivity.
A.reason_against: May cover familiar concepts, so less impactful for some.

B.reason_for: Practical skills are useful but requires laptops and Excel knowledge.
B.reason_against: Not suitable for all employees due to required materials and skills.

C.reason_for: Directly helps organize tasks and improve work efficiency.

D.reason_for: Important awareness topic for all employees.
D.reason_against: Technical content might be challenging and less engaging.

personas.name: Liam
personas.background: Liam is a communications specialist who values clear and effective interaction.
personas.private_goal: To choose a workshop that enhances communication skills across the office.

A.reason_for: Effective communication improves collaboration and reduces misunderstandings.

B.reason_for: Hands-on data skills are valuable but limited to those with Excel knowledge.
B.reason_against: Requires laptops and prior skills, reducing accessibility.

C.reason_for: Time management techniques help improve productivity office-wide.
C.reason_against: Some may find it less applicable to their style.

D.reason_for: Cybersecurity is important but may be too technical for some.
D.reason_against: Could be challenging for non-technical participants.

personas.name: Nina
personas.background: Nina is an IT support specialist who prioritizes security and awareness.
personas.private_goal: To promote a workshop that raises cybersecurity knowledge among all employees.

A.reason_against: May be less urgent compared to security awareness.

B.reason_for: Useful data skills but limited by required prior knowledge and materials.
B.reason_against: Not accessible to all, and less relevant to her focus.

C.reason_for: Helpful for productivity but less critical than security topics.
C.reason_against: Some techniques may not fit everyone’s work style.

D.reason_for: Raises essential awareness of security risks and safe practices.
